# NEW 2026-11-22 v10.0 Worker 4 Slot 81: Eurasian Economy 2.0 — O(1) 12-Hub Grain/Silver/Credit Network (oe_econ2_, 0 vanilla overrides). Generated by gen_eurasia_econ2.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Decision 1: Open Ever-Normal Granaries for Price-Stabilizing Famine & Little Ice Age Relief
oe_econ2_dec_open_granary_relief = {
	decision_category = oe_cat_economic_canals
	hide_repeatable_tag = yes
	potential = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		OR = {
			oe_econ2_needs_granary_relief = yes
			oe_econ2_has_granary_network = yes
		}
	}
	allow = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = oe_econ2_player_only_tt
			is_ai = no
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = oe_econ2_granary_cd_tt
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_econ2_granary_relief_cd }
		}
		gold >= 50
	}
	ai_will_do = { value = 0 }
	illustration_tags = { 10 = interior }
	illustration_scope = {
		event_illustration_poptype_effect = {
			foreground = pop_type:peasants
			background = pop_type:burghers
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = oe_econ2_dec_open_granary_relief.a
		effect = {
			set_variable = { name = oe_econ2_granary_relief_cd months = 36 }
			if = {
				limit = { oe_econ2_has_granary_network = yes }
				add_gold = -45
			}
			else = {
				add_gold = -80
			}
			add_stability = stability_mild_bonus
			add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_econ2_granary_relief_mod years = 5 mode = replace }
			if = {
				limit = { exists = capital }
				capital = {
					if = {
						limit = { exists = market }
						market = {
							add_goods_supply = { goods = goods:wheat amount = 35 }
							add_temporary_demand = { type = demand:oe_econ2_granary_stabilize_demand years = 2 }
						}
					}
				}
			}
			every_province = {
				limit = { is_starving = yes }
				change_province_food_percentage = 0.30
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_active_disaster = disaster_type:oe_cri2_little_ice_age }
				oe_cri2_bump_lia_relief = { amount = 1 }
			}
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_econ2.6
		}
	}
}

# Decision 2: Charter Intercontinental Sovereign Clearinghouse (bridges v9.7 bonds & v12.5 Silver Revolution)
oe_econ2_dec_charter_clearing_house = {
	decision_category = oe_cat_economic_canals
	only_once = yes
	only_once_scope = country
	potential = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		NOT = { has_variable = oe_econ2_clearinghouse_chartered }
		OR = {
			oe_econ2_is_hub_holder = yes
			oe_eco_v97_has_bank_or_company = yes
			current_age_or_later = { age = age_3_discovery }
		}
	}
	allow = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = oe_econ2_player_only_tt
			is_ai = no
		}
		gold >= 150
		stability >= 5
	}
	ai_will_do = { value = 0 }
	illustration_tags = { 10 = interior }
	illustration_scope = {
		event_illustration_poptype_effect = {
			foreground = pop_type:burghers
			background = pop_type:nobles
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = oe_econ2_dec_charter_clearing_house.a
		effect = {
			add_gold = -150
			set_variable = { name = oe_econ2_clearinghouse_chartered value = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_variable = oe_econ2_clearing_tier }
				change_global_variable = { name = oe_econ2_clearing_tier add = 1 }
			}
			else = {
				set_global_variable = { name = oe_econ2_clearing_tier value = 2 }
			}
			add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_econ2_clearinghouse_charter_mod years = 25 mode = replace }
			oe_econ2_inject_clearing_markets = yes
			if = {
				limit = { has_active_disaster = disaster_type:oe_cri2_silver_price_revolution }
				oe_cri2_bump_silver_reform = { amount = 1 }
			}
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_econ2.13
		}
	}
}

# Decision 3: Sponsor Intercontinental Grain Escorts & Canal Dredging
oe_econ2_dec_reopen_grain_corridor = {
	decision_category = oe_cat_economic_canals
	hide_repeatable_tag = yes
	potential = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		OR = {
			owns = location:constantinople
			owns = location:cairo
			owns = location:alexandria
			owns = location:dadu
			owns = location:shangyuan
			owns = location:gdansk
		}
	}
	allow = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = oe_econ2_player_only_tt
			is_ai = no
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = oe_econ2_escort_cd_tt
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_econ2_escort_cd }
		}
		gold >= 80
	}
	ai_will_do = { value = 0 }
	illustration_tags = { 10 = exterior }
	illustration_scope = {
		event_illustration_poptype_effect = {
			foreground = pop_type:burghers
			background = pop_type:peasants
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = oe_econ2_dec_reopen_grain_corridor.a
		effect = {
			add_gold = -80
			set_variable = { name = oe_econ2_escort_cd years = 10 }
			remove_country_modifier = oe_econ2_grain_corridor_shock
			add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_econ2_grain_escort_mod years = 10 mode = replace }
			oe_eco_v97_inject_grain_markets = yes
			oe_econ2_eval_grain_corridors = yes
		}
	}
}
